mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of sustained GDP growth, or during recessions when GDP growth is positive but returns fail to follow.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, reducing wage growth pressures and boosting corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or returns revert to negative when unemployment rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward trend in both quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust demand across sectors, leading to increased corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not correlate significantly with the combined trend of GDPC1 and HOUST (p > 0.05), or returns are negative despite rising demand indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% during a 'late-cycle expansion' signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansions with FEDFUNDS < 2.0% are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or returns revert to negative when rates rise.

mechanism_narrative: An upward movement in the production index (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates strong supply-side growth, reducing production bottlenecks and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or returns revert to negative when production growth slows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and a decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% creates conflicting signals: monetary tightening and strong labor demand, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 4.0% occur, or returns remain positive despite the conflicting indicators.

mechanism_narrative: During a 'monetary tightening cycle', a sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals higher inflation expectations, leading to market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not turn negative during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS increases above 4.5%, or returns remain positive when rates stabilize.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the production index (INDPRO) above 105.0 over multiple quarters indicates robust supply-side growth, reducing production constraints and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during periods of sustained INDPRO growth above 105.0, or returns revert to negative when production growth slows.
